items.question: 어제 회원가입 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT event_count AS signup_count
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1
  AND event_name = 'is_signup';

items.question: 최근 7일 클릭이 가장 많이 발생한 페이지 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT page_path, SUM(event_count) AS click_count
FROM agg_event_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND event_name = 'auto_click'
GROUP BY page_path
ORDER BY click_count DESC, page_path
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 지난주 매출 합계(원)는?
items.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(conversion_value_sum), 0) AS last_week_revenue_krw
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date;

items.question: 최근 30일 세션이 가장 많은 도시 5곳은?
items.sql:
SELECT
  city,
  SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 30
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC, city ASC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 어제 브라우저별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT browser, SUM(sessions) AS sessions
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1
GROUP BY browser
ORDER BY sessions DESC;

items.question: 최근 7일 /products 페이지의 평균 체류 시간(초)은?
items.sql:
SELECT SUM(time_on_page_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(page_views), 0) AS avg_time_on_page_seconds
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND page_path = '/products';

items.question: 최근 7일 페이지뷰 200회 이상인 페이지 중 종료율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  page_path,
  SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views,
  SUM(exits) AS total_exits,
  SUM(exits) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(page_views), 0) AS exit_rate_pct
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY page_path
HAVING SUM(page_views) >= 200
ORDER BY exit_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3;

items.question: 지난주 신규 방문자 수와 재방문자 수는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH last_week_visitors AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7)
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
),
prior_visitors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT client_id
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7)
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.client_id IS NULL THEN l.client_id END) AS new_visitors,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.client_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.client_id END) AS returning_visitors
FROM last_week_visitors l
LEFT JOIN prior_visitors p ON p.client_id = l.client_id;

items.question: 이번 달 일별 매출 추이를 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT summary_date, SUM(conversion_value_sum) AS daily_revenue
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 최근 7일 운영체제(OS)별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  device_os,
  SUM(sessions)::bigint AS session_count
FROM agg_user_session_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY device_os
ORDER BY session_count DESC;

items.question: 어제 장바구니에 상품을 담은 방문자 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT unique_users AS yesterday_add_to_cart_visitors
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE summary_date = current_date - 1
  AND event_name = 'add_to_cart';

items.question: 최근 14일 카카오(kakao) 유입의 매체별 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
  traffic_medium,
  SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND traffic_source = 'kakao'
GROUP BY traffic_medium
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC;

items.question: 지난주 /checkout 에서 /checkout/success 로 이동한 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT SUM(sessions) AS checkout_to_success_sessions
FROM agg_funnel_links_daily
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  AND source = '/checkout'
  AND target = '/checkout/success';
